newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Usiminas still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Usiminas still a buy.

text.p: -- Credit Lyonnais Securities said it was maintaining its buy recommendation on Brazilian steelmaker Usiminas.
-- It said it sees Usiminas "as a strong long-term steel player in Brazil due to its focused strategy, solid local client base and top-quality product line."
-- It said it estimates Usiminas net income at $158 million for the second half of 1996, up 39 percent from the first half.
-- Usiminas preferred was flat at 1.05 reais at 1105 local/1405 GMT on the Sao Paulo bourse.
